exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: Requires a GitHub App — not available with PAT in local mode
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add the secrets and variables below to the repo's Actions settings before the workflow runs.
exportWizard.bundleNote: Runner bundle ({size}) — added as is, not shown here.
exportWizard.optionsLockedNotice: The workflow was edited, so these options are locked. Use “Reset to generated” in Preview to change them.
exportWizard.secretHint: Add it to the repo's Actions secrets
exportWizard.variableHint: Add it to the repo's Actions variables, set to:
exportWizard.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
exportWizard.loopbackWarning: {baseUrl} points to this machine; set {variable} to an address the CI runner can reach.
exportWizard.loopbackWarningNoVariable: {baseUrl} points to this machine; set the base URL variable to an address the CI runner can reach.
exportWizard.selfHostedNote: This agent uses {name} at {host}. GitHub-hosted runners reach only public addresses; if {host} is on a private network, use a self-hosted runner that can reach it.
exportWizard.requiredCheckNote: Blocking merges needs “Fail CI on” on the agent plus a required status check named {check} in the repository's branch protection.
exportWizard.methodZipBody: Downloads {name} with the same files at their repo paths. Nothing is written to GitHub.
exportWizard.nextAddSecrets: Add the secrets and variables below to the repository's Actions settings first — the check on the new pull request fails until they exist.
exportWizard.nextRequiredCheck: To block merges, set the required status check {check}.

gitlab.notConnected: Not connected — add a GitLab connection for {host}
gitlab.triggersNote: GitLab runs merge request pipelines on every push; trigger choices do not apply
gitlab.requiredCheckNote: Blocking merges needs “Fail CI on” on the agent plus “Pipelines must succeed” in the project's Settings › Merge requests.
gitlab.includeBoxIntro: Your project already has {path}. Add this include to it:
gitlab.warnWorkflowRules: If your workflow:rules exclude merge request pipelines, the review job cannot run
gitlab.warnStagesTest: Your stages must include test, or change the job's stage
gitlab.variableHint: Add it as a masked, not protected CI/CD variable
gitlab.tokenHint: scope api; a project access token with the Reporter role is recommended (on gitlab.com project access tokens need Premium or Ultimate; otherwise use a personal access token of a dedicated user). Add it as a masked, not protected CI/CD variable
gitlab.visibleVariableHint: Add it as a visible CI/CD variable, set to:
gitlab.installCardTitle: Open a merge request with these files
gitlab.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a merge request in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
gitlab.methodZipBody: Downloads {name} with the same files at their repo paths. Nothing is written to GitLab.
gitlab.secretNote: Add the CI/CD variables below in the project's Settings › CI/CD › Variables before the merge request pipeline runs.
gitlab.nextAddVariables: Add the CI/CD variables below first — the pipeline of the new merge request fails until they exist.
gitlab.nextInclude: Add the include shown below to {path}.
gitlab.nextPipelinesMustSucceed: To block merges on blockers, enable Settings › Merge requests › Pipelines must succeed.

publishDialog.title: Publish to CI
publishDialog.subtitle: Run {agentName} on every pull request in {repo}
publishDialog.intro: Opens a pull request in {repo} adding a GitHub Actions workflow + this agent's config under .devdigest/. On every PR the agent reviews the diff.
publishDialog.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is provided automatically.
publishDialog.doneBody: Opened/updated a pull request in {repo} with the workflow + agent config.
